## The question

[how to create parser for TEX?](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3814825/how-to-create-parser-for-tex), asked by [Akash Kava](https://stackoverflow.com/users/85597/akash-kava) on Stack Overflow (2010-09-28; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I am looking to develop a TEX parser, now problem is there is no Context Free Grammar and there can not be one, because its not context free language, I heard that it is some sort of macro language and that builds on its own.
>
> So now I need direction of what kind of grammar this macro language has and how to build anything upon in c#.
>
> I will write the tokenizer and parser, but I need some rules of macro in TEX which are quite hard to find, everywhere else there is documentation about how to use TEX macros.
:::

It depends on how much of TeX you actually want to implement.  [LaTeX2HTML][1] is a perl project which converts LaTex to HTML.  There's also [MathJax][2] which converts TeX math to HTML or MathML.  If you want to see how some non-TeX programs parse TeX look at those.


  [1]: http://www.latex2html.org/
  [2]: http://www.mathjax.org/
